revisions.justification: The original label assumed the negative netting sentence would be omitted (=> MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD). Correct parsing of an explicit 'netting does not apply' yields netting_authorization=false, which the service blocks as NETTING_NOT_AUTHORISED. The label's INTENT (freeze must be blocked) is unchanged; either code satisfies it. Recorded openly; no other label was changed after the first extractor run.
